notes.title: Small Update #4
notes.content:
Dear players,

We released today a new build with again new bug fixes! Here is the list of the changes:

[b]Major bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed : Going from chapter 07B to chapter 08A in Viewpoint mode the path was sometimes locked.
[*] Fixed : in chapter 04B the Drone path was locked if the drone door was activated before first moving the drone.
[*] Fixed : in chapter 08B the wheel had inconsistent rotation behavior for the last puzzle.
[*] Fixed : in chapter 01B the maze sometimes appeared in double on the scroll making it impossible to read.
[*] Fixed : in chapter 05B Removed a collider preventing fluid interaction with the puzzle on ground
[/list]

[b]Minor bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several light issues
[*] Fixed graphical issues around doors
[*] Fixed overall small puzzle interaction issues
[*] Fixed overall hints and checkpoints issues
[*] Improved free movement colliders
[*] Improved overall performance & loading times.
[/list]

Thank you very much for playing our game!!

notes.title: Small Update #3
notes.content:
Dear players, 

We released yesterday a new update with some new bug fixes! Here are the most important ones: 

- Level 1: Fix a clip of the mesh in the airlock
- Level 2: Fix the puzzle with the 3 moving pins 
- Level 3: Fix a checkpoint that was causing the eye in the conference room to disappear
- Level 4: Fix the blocking bug at the opening of the cryopod
- Level 5: Fix the checkpoint that leads to the puzzle switch of gravity; correction of the opening of the gravity core, which could be finished even if some elements of the puzzle were not completed
- Level 6: New lights for some elements; fixed a bug where if you didn't take the letter in engine you couldn't go back to it; fix some transitions
- Level 7: New sign added to secu for the screen puzzle
- Level 8: The shield around the ship now rotates directly around the ship when the rudder is used; returning to a checkpoint no longer causes part of the ship to disappear
ALL SCENES : Fix some skip buttons get past puzzles that might not work; fix transitions with new loading system to avoid seeing the void

Once again, thank you everyone for playing Machinika Atlas!

notes.title: Small Update #2
notes.content:
Dear players, 

Today we're releasing a new update that will bring a lot of new bug fixes! Here are the most important bugs: 

- Fix level 2A black puzzles
- Fix level 2B periscope hint
- Fix the rare bug on the level 3B grid puzzle
- Correction of a bug on the puzzle Drone Eye level 3B
- Level 3B eye animation fixed
- Fix drone position level 7B
- Fix bug on level 7A door
- Fix dialogue bug in level 6A
- Add a light for the letter level 8B
- Fix transition at start of scene level 8B

Thanks again to everyone for playing Machinika Atlas!

notes.title: Small Update #1
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you all for your messages! We're reading you and doing our best to improve your gaming experience and fix as many bugs as possible. 

We've released a dayone patch today with a lot of bug fixes, including the following: 

[list]
[*] Fixed a blocking bug when acquiring the drone in level 3
[*] Fixed a rare bug in chapter 1 where the planetarium (sphere) is very far away and blocks the game
[*] Fixed a bug in chapter 3 where the articulated arm is visible under the table
[*] Fixed a bug in chapter 4 where it was impossible to move the puzzle pieces that move the crane 
[/list]

We know that there are still bugs to be fixed, and we're doing everything we can to fix them so that we can apply several patches over the next few days.

Thank you very much!
